Tempest Magic & Tempest Energy
Tempest Energy
is a
Weather Witching
mechanic which is primarily used to enable the Tempest Flight sidebar abilities. Once a Weather Witch learns Tempest Flight, they will begin to accumulate
Tempest Energy.
Tempest Energy is expended when Tempest Flight is used.
Tempest Energy will cap at 2xMob Level, so killing level 50 mobs will only raise your Tempest Energy to 100 max.
Tempest Energy is regained when defeating enemies using
Weather Witching
.
The initial maximum Tempest Energy is 100. Raising the level of
Weather Witching
increases the maximum total Tempest Energy which can be accumulated.
